mechanism_claims.claim_text: HR2P inhibits MERS-CoV entry/fusion by targeting the viral HR1 domain and blocking formation of the six-helix-bundle fusion core.
direct_assay_types: crystal structure of HR1-L6-HR2 fusion core
mechanism_claims.limitations: Direct membrane fusion/entry mechanism is supported; no claim is made for bacterial membrane permeabilization or nucleic-acid binding.
